from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A specific month's housing construction data extracted from a single report."""
    release_date: str | None = Field(description="Date the report was released, to resolve precedence among conflicting data points")
    target_month: str | None = Field(description="The month this data represents, in YYYY-MM format")
    authorizations: float | None = Field(description="Not Seasonally Adjusted total building permits/authorizations for the target month, in thousands")
    starts: float | None = Field(description="Not Seasonally Adjusted total housing starts for the target month, in thousands")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_data_points: list[MonthlyDataPoint]
